steps.label: Territorial Waters
steps.caption: Vessel crosses the maritime boundary into national territorial waters.

steps.label: Customs Boundary
steps.caption: Customs jurisdiction attaches under the statutory charging provision.

steps.label: Continuous Process
steps.caption: Importation continues until goods cross the physical customs barrier.

steps.label: Tariff Date Lock
steps.caption: Tariff rates lock on the presentation date of bill of entry.

steps.label: Arrival Manifest
steps.caption: Master delivers the electronic cargo manifest prior to vessel arrival.

steps.label: Entry Inwards
steps.caption: Proper customs officer reviews records and grants entry inwards order.

steps.label: Bill of Entry
steps.caption: Importer files white bill of entry for immediate home consumption.

steps.label: Out of Charge
steps.caption: Inspector completes examination and issues the out of charge release.

steps.label: Title Endorsement
steps.caption: Consignee endorses negotiable bill of lading while goods are on high seas.

steps.label: Contract Transfer
steps.caption: Contract transfers title to buyer prior to customs port clearance.

steps.label: Schedule Three Scope
steps.caption: Transaction qualifies as statutory non-supply exempt from sales tax.

steps.label: Customs Assessment
steps.caption: Customs assessment calculates duties on the final contract price.

steps.label: Trade Code Setup
steps.caption: Exporter registers verified trade identification code on customs portal.

steps.label: Entry Outwards
steps.caption: Master secures entry outwards authorization before embarking cargo.

steps.label: Inspection Review
steps.caption: Officer inspects goods and verifies mandatory non-prohibition checks.

steps.label: Let Export Order
steps.caption: Proper officer issues let export order allowing loading onto vessel.

steps.label: Currency Conversion
steps.caption: Simulator converts foreign invoice currency at notified exchange rates.

steps.label: Basic Customs Duty
steps.caption: Engine computes basic customs duty on the statutory assessable base.

steps.label: Social Welfare Fee
steps.caption: Surcharge attaches at ten percent on the primary basic customs duty.

steps.label: Integrated Tax Base
steps.caption: Integrated tax applies on cumulative sum of assessable base and duties.
